## Motivation

Fixes #44474.

With effective tools and no configured tool-call parser, `tool_choice="required"` and named tool choices already get the JSON fallback constraint, which constrains the intended output to `[{"name": ..., "parameters": ...}]`. But both Chat response paths were gated by `_tool_call_parsing_active`, which requires a configured parser, so a generated fallback call ending with `stop` came back as plain `content` with `finish_reason="stop"`. The docs say `required` forces at least one tool call, and the Responses implementation already has a JSON fallback for required and named choices that does not require a configured tool-call parser.

## Modifications

`python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py`:

- Add `_should_parse_tool_calls`, which is true when a configured parser is active (the existing helper) or when effective tools are present and the choice is `required` or a named tool.
- Use it for the two response-path gates: the streaming tool-call branch and the non-streaming tool-call parsing. Both then reach the existing JSON fallback in `_process_tool_calls` and `_process_tool_call_stream`; no new parsing code.
- Include constrained JSON parsing in the streaming logprob flush condition, so logprobs of deltas the fallback consumes are still sent.
- The logic of `_tool_call_parsing_active` is unchanged, preserving the reasoning-parser inputs and framing decisions. Its docstring now explicitly describes the configured parser.

`auto` and `none`, requests without effective tools, and configured parsers behave as before; public validation still rejects `required` and named choices without tools.

The existing JSON streaming fallback can still emit an empty argument string when the whole call arrives in a single terminal delta; the same behavior is reproducible at `f7ad4345` with `glm45` configured.

Tests in `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py` (six methods):

- `required` without a parser (two methods: non-streaming and streaming with two cumulative chunks): one `get_weather` call with `{"location": "Tokyo"}`, no content, `finish_reason == "tool_calls"`;
- a named tool choice without a parser, non-streaming;
- streaming logprobs over two cumulative chunks without a parser, for `required` and a named choice: the call is parsed and the two supplied token logprobs are each sent exactly once;
- a configured `hermes` parser with `auto` and native-format output, in both modes;
- plain-content controls for `auto` with tools, `none` with tools, and `required` with no effective tools (response path only), in both modes.

I ran the following locally on CPU with Python 3.12.15 and PyTorch 2.14.1+cpu:

- At `a0bc728f`, `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=python ~/venvs/sg/bin/python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py -q`: 162 passed, 123 subtests passed.
- With these tests and the `f7ad4345` `serving_chat.py`: 5 failed, 159 passed, 121 subtests passed. The required non-streaming, required streaming, named non-streaming, and both logprob subtests fail at the tool-call assertion (`[] != ['get_weather']`); all controls pass.
- `uvx pre-commit run --files python/sglang/srt/entrypoints/openai/serving_chat.py test/registered/unit/entrypoints/openai/test_serving_chat.py`: all hooks pass.

## Accuracy Tests

Not applicable: no model, kernel or sampling change. GPU/model E2E tests and a live server were not run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

+    def _should_parse_tool_calls(self, request: ChatCompletionRequest) -> bool:
+        """Whether the response should parse native or constrained JSON tool calls."""
+        return self._tool_call_parsing_active(request) or bool(
+            self._effective_tools(request)
+            and (
+                request.tool_choice == "required"
+                or isinstance(request.tool_choice, ToolChoice)

                     text,

@@ -2223,6 +2223,148 @@ def test_non_streaming_tool_call_index_is_the_call_ordinal(self):
         )

+    def _tool_choice_response(self, choice, *, stream=False, parser=None, tools=True):
+        self.chat.tool_call_parser = parser
+        payload = '[{"name":"get_weather","parameters":{"location":"Tokyo"}}]'
+        if parser:
+            payload = (
+                '<tool_call>{"name":"get_weather",'
+                '"arguments":{"location":"Tokyo"}}</tool_call>'
+            )
+        request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+            model="x",
+            messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Weather?"}],
+            tools=(
+                [{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather"}}]
+                if tools
+                else None
+            ),
+            tool_choice=choice,
+            stream=stream,
+        )
+        if not stream:
+            result = _spec_result(0)
+            result["text"] = payload
+            response = self.chat._build_chat_response(request, [result], created=0)
+            choice_data = response.choices[0].model_dump()
+            choice_data["delta"] = choice_data.pop("message")
+            return [choice_data], payload
+
+        async def generate():
+            for end in (len(payload) // 2, len(payload)):
+                result = _spec_result(0)
+                result["text"] = payload[:end]
+                if end < len(payload):
+                    result["meta_info"]["finish_reason"] = None
+                yield result
+
+        self.tm.generate_request.return_value = generate()
+        chunks = self._parse_chunks(self._run_chat_stream(None, request))
+        self.assertFalse(any("error" in chunk for chunk in chunks))
+        return [choice for chunk in chunks for choice in chunk["choices"]], payload
+
+    def _assert_weather_tool_response(self, choices):
+        calls = [
+            call
+            for choice in choices
+            for call in (choice["delta"].get("tool_calls") or [])
+        ]
+        self.assertEqual(
+            [
+                call["function"]["name"]
+                for call in calls
+                if call["function"].get("name")
+            ],
+            ["get_weather"],
+        )
+        self.assertEqual({call["index"] for call in calls}, {0})
+        self.assertEqual(
+            json.loads("".join(call["function"]["arguments"] or "" for call in calls)),
+            {"location": "Tokyo"},
+        )
+        self.assertFalse(any(choice["delta"].get("content") for choice in choices))
+        self.assertEqual(choices[-1]["finish_reason"], "tool_calls")
+
+    def test_required_tool_choice_without_parser_non_streaming(self):
+        """Required JSON output must become tool calls instead of plain content."""
+        choices, _ = self._tool_choice_response("required")
+        self._assert_weather_tool_response(choices)
+
+    def test_required_tool_choice_without_parser_streaming(self):
+        """Required JSON fragments must become tool deltas and finish as tool_calls."""
+        choices, _ = self._tool_choice_response("required", stream=True)
+        self._assert_weather_tool_response(choices)
+
+    def test_named_tool_choice_without_parser(self):
+        named = ToolChoice(function=ToolChoiceFuncName(name="get_weather"))
+        choices, _ = self._tool_choice_response(named)
+        self._assert_weather_tool_response(choices)
+
+    def test_tool_choice_without_parser_streaming_keeps_logprobs(self):
+        """The JSON fallback may consume deltas; their logprobs must still be sent once."""
+        self.chat.tool_call_parser = None
+        self.chat.reasoning_parser = None
+        payload = '[{"name":"get_weather","parameters":{"location":"Tokyo"}}]'
+        named = ToolChoice(function=ToolChoiceFuncName(name="get_weather"))
+        for choice in ("required", named):
+            with self.subTest(choice=choice):
+                request = ChatCompletionRequest(
+                    model="x",
+                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Weather?"}],
+                    tools=[{"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather"}}],
+                    tool_choice=choice,
+                    stream=True,
+                    logprobs=True,
+                )
+
+                async def generate():
+                    for n, end in enumerate((len(payload) // 2, len(payload)), 1):
+                        result = _spec_result(0)
+                        result["text"] = payload[:end]
+                        result["meta_info"].update(
+                            finish_reason=None if n == 1 else {"type": "stop"},
+                            output_token_logprobs=[(-0.1, 1, "a"), (-0.2, 2, "b")][:n],
+                            output_top_logprobs=[],
+                            output_token_logprobs_length=n,
+                        )
+                        yield result
+
+                self.tm.generate_request.return_value = generate()
+                chunks = self._parse_chunks(self._run_chat_stream(None, request))
+                self.assertFalse(any("error" in chunk for chunk in chunks))
+                choices = [c for chunk in chunks for c in chunk["choices"]]
+                self._assert_weather_tool_response(choices)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    [
+                        token["token"]
+                        for c in choices
+                        for token in (c.get("logprobs") or {}).get("content") or []
+                    ],
+                    ["a", "b"],
+                )
+
+    def test_tool_choice_with_native_parser_control(self):
+        for stream in (False, True):
+            with self.subTest(stream=stream):
+                choices, _ = self._tool_choice_response(
+                    "auto", stream=stream, parser="hermes"
+                )
+                self._assert_weather_tool_response(choices)
+
+    def test_tool_choice_plain_content_controls(self):
+        for choice, tools in (("auto", True), ("none", True), ("required", False)):
+            for stream in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(choice=choice, tools=tools, stream=stream):
+                    choices, payload = self._tool_choice_response(
+                        choice, stream=stream, tools=tools
+                    )
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        "".join(c["delta"].get("content") or "" for c in choices),
+                        payload,
+                    )
+                    self.assertFalse(any(c["delta"].get("tool_calls") for c in choices))
+                    self.assertEqual(choices[-1]["finish_reason"], "stop")
+
